vulnerabilities.title: LLM01 - Prompt Injection
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-94 (Improper Control of Generation of Code), CWE-77 (Command Injection)
vulnerabilities.description: Manipulating LLMs via crafted inputs to change behavior, including indirect injection through tools or documents, enabling data exfiltration or unintended actions.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Input/output sanitization, instruction-data separation, least-privilege tool access, output filtering, human review for high-impact actions.

vulnerabilities.title: LLM02 - Insecure Output Handling
vulnerabilities.description: Treating LLM output as trusted without validation, leading to XSS, command injection, or unsafe downstream action.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Validate, encode, and sanitize all LLM outputs; treat output as untrusted at every downstream boundary.

vulnerabilities.title: Data poisoning
vulnerabilities.description: Adversarial manipulation of training data to backdoor, bias, or degrade model behavior.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Dataset provenance and integrity, anomaly detection, poisoned-data filtering, re-evaluation of model behavior.

vulnerabilities.title: Model and data extraction
vulnerabilities.description: Query-based reconstruction of model behavior or extraction of memorized training data.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Rate limiting, query monitoring, membership attack detection, access control.

vulnerabilities.title: Excessive agency in agentic systems
vulnerabilities.description: Agentic systems granted excessive autonomy, privilege, or tool access leading to unintended high-impact or irreversible actions.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Limit autonomy, enforce least-privilege tool access, add human approval gates, document and constrain permitted actions.

vulnerabilities.title: Sensitive information disclosure
vulnerabilities.description: Model or application discloses personal, sensitive, or regulated data via outputs or retrieval.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Data minimization, output redaction/filtering, access controls on retrieval, DPIA.

vulnerabilities.title: Agent framework authentication bypass and unauthenticated remote code execution via MCP
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-306 (Missing Authentication), CWE-94 (Improper Control of Generation of Code), CWE-306/CWE-287
vulnerabilities.description: AI agent frameworks expose unauthenticated MCP endpoints that let remote attackers bypass authentication and achieve remote code execution, often through automatic-login defaults or MCP tool enumeration.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Upgrade to patched versions (Langflow >= 1.13.0); disable automatic login in production; restrict MCP endpoint exposure; apply authentication and network controls to MCP servers.

vulnerabilities.title: Sandbox escape in AI-generated code execution
affected_components: Generative UI tools (e.g., Prefab Generative UI)
vulnerabilities.description: Sandboxes that execute model-written code start with excessive privileges, letting generated code read/write host files or reach host systems as the server user.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Revoke read/write/network permissions before accepting code (fixed in prefab-ui 0.21.0, Beta9 worker 0.1.756/gateway 0.1.776); avoid exposing generative tools to untrusted clients; run with least privilege and isolation.

vulnerabilities.title: Agentic coding tool time-of-check/time-of-use (TOCTOU) workspace escape
affected_components: Agentic coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code Edit tool)
vulnerabilities.description: A pathname validation divorced from file-descriptor-anchored use lets attacker-controlled code swap a validated path for a symlink, causing an unsandboxed edit/write path to overwrite user files outside the workspace.
vulnerabilities.remediation_summary: Upgrade to patched version (Claude Code >= 2.1.251); pin and review repos, dependency installs, and plugins before agent sessions; verify file-descriptor-anchored path handling.
